scope: Engineering preflight in unchanged RVL CodingToolAgent, not the 32-task research pilot; no training/capability/scaling claim
policy_change: temperature-only diagnostic; weights fixed, no learned checkpoint update
feedback_weak: first upstream assertion only, scalar pass/fail
feedback_strong: all three upstream assertions, scalar pass/fail
hidden_check: separate balanced-parentheses cases generated before model inference, not exposed in prompt or feedback

conformance.feedback_or_action_prompt_mismatch: discard all remaining donor actions; do not resume reuse
conformance.complete_group: both members retained, no reward/length/completion selection
conformance.insufficient_budget: retain unfinished work, no extra attempt
conformance.no_observation_disagreement: report feedback-repair branch untested; do not alter verifier/task

cost_accounting: charge donor generation to both async-discard baseline and repair, separately report fresh-from-scratch; charge load, q/p reconstruction, target prefill, decoding, feedback, all invalid/unfinished calls; Metal wall time is not CUDA GPU-seconds
decision: Pass only establishes collector/preflight feasibility. Cannot pass original >=15% GPU-second and <=1pp capability-loss gate. Reconstruction failure blocks exact-reuse integration; no tuned rerun. No model/task variants after outcomes.
